name: Call Battery Saver
description: Uses less battery in voice calls while you are muted or deafened: skips noise cancellation (Krisp) while muted, can pause the rest of the mic processing, pauses other people's cameras while deafened, and can remind you or leave the call after a while.
author: MarkLong0467 (https://github.com/MarkLong0467 "GitHub")
contributors: Found with the decompiled Discord app by Wumpus-Central (discord-mobile-datamining)
